I answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket for the West yard Door 2 double-booking is **#8841**.

That number comes from Tobias's own message in #central-random on Oct 13. He said the door is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. I took this to be the Marrow Fieldworks ticket because Hollis called it "Tobias's dealer account" in that same thread. A public Central team handoff note from January also shows Marrow Fieldworks changing hands then. Neither message names Marrow Fieldworks outright, so that link is my inference. I only used channels and files Tobias can see himself.

Earlier, in a direct message, Tobias guessed the ticket might end up as OPS-7485 and asked me to keep that private. I didn't mention it in the channel.
